additional_source_informed_controls.name: RESISTOR_0
additional_source_informed_controls.role: series RC compensation resistance Ra; trades intermediate pole-zero placement against high parasitic pole

compensation_guidance.CAPACITOR_0: Cm outer Miller capacitor; extending upper bound above released 0.5pF is physically justified to reduce crossover if adapted model is unstable
compensation_guidance.CAPACITOR_1: Ca intermediate-node RC capacitor; require empirical pole separation, not independent monotone optimization
compensation_guidance.RESISTOR_0: Ra changes pnd2 approximately gm2*Ra*gm3/CL and pnd3 approximately 1/(Ra*C2); increasing Ra helps one pole but hurts another
compensation_guidance.paper_equations: 19,22,23,26,32,33; approximations presume large stage gains and compensation capacitances exceeding corresponding parasitics
